page.title: Passports & Visas
page.subtitle: Keep every passport. Connect every journey.
actions.confirmDelete: This cannot be undone. Unlink dependent records before deleting a document, or archive an old passport instead.
messages.loadFailed: Unable to load records: {message}. Select “Retry” to try again.
messages.needPassport: Add a passport in the Passports tab before adding other records.
notices.passports: Archive an old passport after renewal to keep its visas and travel history.
notices.visas: Entries are counted when the entry date is reached. Leave the allowance blank for unlimited entries. An entered remaining balance stays fixed; update it or clear it to resume calculation.
notices.stays: Entry and departure locations are free text and may be in different countries. The travel passport can differ from the passport holding the visa.
empty.passportHint: Start your travel records by adding your first passport.
empty.visaHint: Add a visa to complete your travel records.
empty.stayHint: Add a border crossing to complete your travel history.
hints.passportId: An old passport can still hold a valid visa after renewal.
hints.totalEntries: Enter 1 for single entry or 2 for double entry. Leave blank for unlimited entries.
hints.maxStayDays: Optional. Country-specific rolling stay limits are not calculated.
hints.remainingEntriesOverride: Replaces the calculated balance with a fixed value. Update it as needed, or clear it to resume calculation.
hints.visaId: You can use a visa from an old passport. Leave blank for visa-free travel or incomplete records.
hints.exitDate: Leave blank until departure, then complete it later.
hints.stayDaysOverride: Clear to resume calculation through today, including the arrival and departure days.
errors.invalidInteger: {field} must be a whole number between 0 and 1000000
errors.passportDateOrder: Passport expiry must not precede its issue date
errors.passportStatus: Select a current or archived passport
errors.visaDateOrder: Visa expiry must not precede its start date
errors.storage: Unable to save or load records. Please try again later.
errors.missingReference: The record or linked document no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
errors.linkedRecords: This document still has linked records. Unlink or delete them first, or archive an old passport instead.
errors.request: The request failed. Please try again.
empty.applicationHint: Keep a history of submitted, approved and refused visa applications.
notices.applications: Record every application separately. Only approved applications can create a visa; refused or withdrawn applications stay in your history.
hints.applicationId: Optional. Choose an approved application to fill its passport, country and visa type. Each application can be linked to one visa.
errors.applicationDateOrder: The decision date must not precede the application date
errors.applicationLinked: This application has a linked visa. Unlink or delete that visa before changing the result, passport or country.
errors.approvalMismatch: The linked application must be approved and match the visa passport and country.
